appended.name: Grafton Group plc
appended.suggestion: Filings-first order is adequate in principle (77 local bodies; 9 annual + 5 interim + 3 trading_update). It is not adequate when period tags are wrong: the only period=annual IR body is the 2025 Annual Report, while FY2025 Final Results, the FY presentation, the CME26 deck, and the July 2026 trading-update PDF are all tagged period=interim. The only true statutory interim is H1 2025 (30 Jun 2025). yahoo_quarterly_cashflow sits on the ladder but is empty (TTM suppressed); alternate_news is a dead step. Trading updates and the Mercaluz completion are first-class for a merchanting/M&A story but sit outside the annual/interim assignment rule.

appended.name: Grafton Group plc
appended.suggestion: Four worker types plus a five-task cap force annual + interim + news + screen + gap and leave no slot for the May 2026 Q1 trading update, the June CME/2030 RNS, Mercaluz completion, or the 30 Jun £25m buyback-programme RNS. summarize_filing_body cannot carry period=annual|interim|trading_update|corporate_action, so the director must smuggle the July 2026 trading update in as ‘interim’ because it is catalogued that way and is the only 2026 intra-year operating body. No task type exists to reconcile the three FCF bases or to cluster ~50 Transaction-in-Own-Shares RNSs.

appended.name: Grafton Group plc
appended.suggestion: The screen emits strong_buy (11/22, 5 families including quality/GARP/dividend) while FCF Yield fails at 0.1% despite £168–206m FCF — a contradiction that should have tripped fcf_basis_overlay / divergence_flagged (both false). cyclical_exposure_detected is false on a UK/Irish builders-merchant; interim_quality_overlay is false despite empty Yahoo quarterlies and no H1 2026 statutory interim; cash_conversion_overlay is false despite FCF definitions disagreeing. Quality/GARP can pass while Buffett/Moat/Quality Value fail on the same 8.4% ROE. The director–worker loop is being asked to qualitatively veto a mechanically clean headline that the overlays failed to brake.

appended.name: Grafton Group plc
appended.suggestion: weeks_at_signal=1 / stability=new / conviction=0.475 already mark a fresh print, but there is no watch schema for: next true H1 2026 results (absent from catalog on 4 Sep 2026), remaining £25m buyback capacity, Mercaluz integration, CME 2030 KPI checkpoints, or UK/Irish merchanting LFL. RSI 56 + MACD-weakening in the action_note is not a substitute for those monitors. A 1-week strong_buy with limits below live buyback prints needs a price-vs-signal freshness check, not just a stability label.

appended.name: Grafton Group plc
appended.suggestion: A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend UK Selco-type merchanting, Irish Woodie’s, and Iberian distribution and will not force like-for-like vs acquired growth, statutory vs adjusted, or cash vs lease-adjusted net debt. Without an explicit CAPITAL RETURNS slot, workers will treat the daily £25m buyback flood as news colour rather than a denominator/FCF-cover fact. No required slot for CH-entity hygiene (UK 02886378 vs Irish group) or for FCF-definition reconciliation. Director catalog pass can form these questions without drafting the memo.
